issues.description: In the template for Exercise 5 (template_repository/ex5_grover_kakuro.py) the state_preparation method uses the parameter name ancilla_register, while the rest of the template, the solution implementation, and the problem statement consistently refer to this conceptual entity as auxiliary_register (or 'auxiliary qubit/register'). This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual entity (auxiliary/ancilla register) is likely to confuse students: the constructor and other methods expect auxiliary_register, the docstring for state_preparation mentions auxiliary_register, but the method signature uses ancilla_register. A student following the template or the problem text could be uncertain which name to use when implementing or calling methods, increasing extraneous cognitive load and causing trivial but frustrating errors.
issues.suggested_fix: Use a single consistent identifier for the auxiliary register across all artifacts. Change the state_preparation parameter name in template_repository/ex5_grover_kakuro.py from ancilla_register to auxiliary_register (and update any internal references if present). Ensure the docstring, signature, and all method calls in the template match 'auxiliary_register' to align with the problem statement and the solution code.
